summary_en: Spain's ruling Socialists have narrowed the gap but continue to trail the conservative People's Party, who would need to team up with the far-right Vox party to secure a majority of seats in parliament, pollsters say with three weeks to go before the country's general election.

title_en: Russian network used social media to blame French riots on immigration, EU report says
summary_en: An internal EU assessment has uncovered a Russian network that aimed to exploit ​last month's riots in France by using social media to blame the unrest on uncontrolled immigration. The assessment, seen by Reuters, offers an insight into how external actors have been exploiting France's domestic turmoil for their ⁠own political ends.

title_en: Shock and grief in Poland after weekend mass shooting
summary_en: Poland was in shock after a weekend mass shooting in which a gunman opened fire, killing six people and wounding 15 in the city of Krakow before police shot and wounded him. The shooter died in the hospital on Monday morning, police said.
